verdict.rationale: The official README documents a non-interactive, CI/CD-friendly install path (`npx skills add vercel-labs/agent-skills --skill frontend-design -g -a claude-code -y`) with flags for selecting skills, agents and scope. A runtime probe confirms the CLI runs keylessly via `npx -y`, detects when a coding agent is driving it, and switches to promptless mode on its own ('installing non-interactively'). missing for 10: hands-on confirmation of a completed headless install with the resulting skill files verified in the agent directory.
